description: This file defines the MqttPendingUnsubscription class, which manages MQTT unsubscription requests, including retransmission handling, within the Thingsboard MQTT client implementation.

classes.name: MqttPendingUnsubscription
classes.description: Manages pending MQTT unsubscription requests, including retransmission logic and lifecycle events.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Builder pattern class for constructing MqttPendingUnsubscription instances with configurable parameters.

methods.name: startRetransmissionTimer
methods.description: Starts the retransmission timer and sets the packet sending handler.

methods.name: onUnsubackReceived
methods.description: Handles receipt of unsubscription acknowledgment, stopping retransmission.

methods.name: onChannelClosed
methods.description: Handles channel closure event, stopping retransmission.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new Builder instance for constructing MqttPendingUnsubscription objects.

methods.name: future
methods.description: Sets the Promise<Void> representing the future completion of the unsubscription.

methods.name: topic
methods.description: Sets the topic string for the unsubscription request.

methods.name: ownerId
methods.description: Sets the owner ID associated with the unsubscription.

methods.name: pendingOperation
methods.description: Sets the pending operation associated with the unsubscription.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an MqttPendingUnsubscription instance with the configured parameters.
